candidates.rationale: SPY at 638.75 is grinding toward the 20-day high of 641.20 with the Fed on hold, and ATM implied vol of 18.45% is modest against a 3% 20-day range. A 640/650 call debit spread for 22 DTE pays roughly 4.55 per share at mid for a 10-point width, so the position needs a move above 644.55 by expiry to profit and caps the loss at the debit.
candidates.key_risk: A hawkish surprise or a growth scare sends SPY back through 630 before expiry and the spread expires worthless.
